title: MEML 75 — Model of Single World Sheet (Version B, ADMX-HF)
description: MEML 75 is a version of the geometric model of particle identity on the T^2/Z_3 orbifold in six-dimensional spacetime. The axion decay constant is derived from first principles. It predicts an axion mass of 28.22 ueV, a resonance frequency of 6.824 GHz, and primordial black holes with a mass of ~0.63 Earth masses.
